lines.en: I make my way over to the dive bar and decide to spend most of the night conversing with Rika since Wakana and Imani are always too mean to me.
lines.zh: 我走到那家小酒吧，决定今晚大半时间都用来和 Rika 聊天，因为 Wakana 和 Imani 对我总是太刻薄了。

lines.en: Thankfully, I'm pretty sure that Rika's brain is incapable of feeling whatever advanced emotions are required to make a person act maliciously, so things flow pretty naturally.
lines.zh: 谢天谢地，我相当确定 Rika 的大脑无法产生那些让人做出恶意行为的高级情绪，所以一切进展得相当自然。

lines.en: And by {i}naturally{/i} I mean that I receive a much-needed ego boost in the form of her thinking I am actually an effective teacher.
lines.zh: 而我说的{i}自然{/i}是指：她真心觉得我是个称职的老师，让我得到了急需的自尊心补给。

lines.en: And while I'm sure that will change given that she's suddenly working in the same building as the rest of us, I can revel in her skewed perception for now-
lines.zh: 虽然我知道，既然她突然跟我们在同一栋楼里工作了，这种看法迟早会变——但眼下我还能在她那偏斜的认知里得意一阵子——

lines.en: Because it's only a matter of time until she finds out who I really am.
lines.zh: 因为她发现我到底是个什么样的人，只是时间问题。

lines.en: As the night carries on, I allow my other coworkers to join in on my fun and exciting conversation with an apparent ex-activist under the pretense of them telling me how great I am.
lines.zh: 夜色渐深，我让其他同事也加入进来，参与我和这位显然是前社会活动家之间那场有趣又刺激的对话——前提是她们得一直夸我有多棒。

lines.en: They take this far too literally and there are very few sentences throughout the rest of my time in the bar that are {i}not{/i} padded with some sort of fake compliment.
lines.zh: 她们把这话理解得太过字面，接下来我在酒吧里说出的每一句话，几乎{i}没有{/i}一句不塞满某种虚假的恭维。

lines.en: But of course Rika, still incapable of ever catching onto anything, keeps talking to me the same exact way she always does.
lines.zh: 但 Rika 当然还是那样，永远察觉不到任何东西，一如既往地用同样的方式跟我说话。

lines.en: And I feel comfortable, the same way I always {i}do.{/i}
lines.zh: 而我感到自在，就像我{i}一直{/i}以来那样。

lines.en: I'm hesitant to say it's her age or accompanying wisdom that manages to make me feel this way given that she both looks and acts at least twenty years younger-
lines.zh: 我不太愿意说，是她的年纪、或是随之而来的智慧让我有这种感觉——毕竟她看起来和做起事来都至少年轻二十岁——

lines.en: But there's something about her that just works for me.
lines.zh: 但她身上有某种东西，就是很对我胃口。

lines.en: And I'm glad I finally met her.
lines.zh: 我很高兴自己终于遇见了她。
